age.evidence: Eightweek-old male C57BL/6J mice (Beijing SPF Biotechnology, Beijing, China)

sex.evidence: Eightweek-old male C57BL/6J mice; 'only male mice were used in this study'

dosing.doses_raw: OFT: 1, 2.5 and 5 mg/kg; FST: 0.1, 0.5, 1.0 and 2.5 mg/kg; i.p. (results: 0.1-5 mg/kg); CORT model: 0.1, 1.0, 2.5 mg/kg
dosing.evidence: Psilocybin was dissolved in 0.9% sterile saline solution and administered by intraperitoneal (i.p.) injection in a volume of 10 ml/kg. ... a single administration

group_housing.evidence: Mice were housed at constant room temperature (22 ± 1°C) ... cage density not stated

day_night_flipped.evidence: 12 h light/dark cycle (lights on from 8:00 A.M. to 8:00 P.M.) ... All behavioural tests were performed between 10:00 A.M. and 12:00 A.M.

assays.assay_description: 40x40x40 cm plastic box; after 2-min acclimation, total distance travelled recorded for 5 min with SMART video tracking, 12 h after single psilocybin (1, 2.5, 5 mg/kg i.p.) or vehicle.

setup_habituation.evidence: Only a within-session 2-min acclimation is described ('After a 2-min acclimation period, the total distance travelled was recorded over the next 5 min'); no prior apparatus exposure reported

food_restriction.evidence: No food in the open field apparatus (plastic box)

water_restriction.evidence: No water in the open field apparatus

time_to_assay.evidence: tested by the open field test (OFT) 12 h post-injection (1, 2.5 and 5 mg/kg)

sample_size.evidence: n = 11-12/group (Figure 1 legend); one-way ANOVA F 3, 43 implies N = 47

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin (1, 2.5, 5 mg/kg) did not alter total distance travelled in the OFT 12 h after a single injection, indicating no effect on basal locomotion.
outcomes.evidence: The OFT results showed that locomotor activity was not altered 12 h after a single administration of psilocybin (one-way ANOVA: F 3, 43 = 1.421, p = 0.2497; Figure 1(b)).

B1_num_measures.evidence: locomotor activity (measured as the total distance travelled)

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Only total distance over the 5-min session reported

B7_automated_classification.evidence: the SMART video tracking system was used to record and analyse the total distance travelled (position tracking)

E2_shelter.evidence: No shelter described in open field box

E3_bedding.evidence: No bedding described for the plastic box

E6_spatial.evidence: box ... divided into equal sectors (virtual zones), single open space

E7_social_context.evidence: Mice were placed in the centre of a plastic box ... allowed to move freely (tested individually)

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water in apparatus

D2_session_duration.evidence: the total distance travelled was recorded over the next 5 min

assays.assay_description: Glass cylinders (20 cm height x 12 cm diameter) with 15 cm water at 24 ± 0.5°C; 6-min video, immobility scored over last 4 min by two blinded observers; tested 12 h, 24 h and 7 days after single psilocybin (0.1–5 mg/kg i.p.) or vehicle in naïve mice.

setup_habituation.evidence: Only room acclimation described: 'The mice were allowed to adapt to the test room for at least 1 h before the test'

setup_restrain.evidence: mice were individually placed in cylindrical containers ... filled with 15 cm of water (FST cylinder)

water_restriction.evidence: No drinking water provided in FST cylinder

time_to_assay.evidence: Mice were subjected to the forced swimming test (FST) 12 h, 24 h and 7 days post-psilocybin

sample_size.evidence: n = 11-12/group (Figure 1 legend); F 5, 66 implies N = 72 across 6 groups

outcomes.summary: A single psilocybin injection (0.1–5 mg/kg) significantly decreased FST immobility at 12 h, 24 h and 7 days post-administration; per the discussion, 0.1–5 mg/kg were effective at 12 h and 24 h and 0.5–2.5 mg/kg at 7 days.
outcomes.evidence: One-way ANOVA showed that 0.1-5 mg/kg psilocybin administration significantly decreased immobility in the FST at 12 h (F 5, 65 = 8.303, p < 0.001), 24 h (F 5, 66 = 8.810, p < 0.001) and 7 days (F 5, 66 = 12.750, p < 0.001)

B1_num_measures.evidence: The immobility time was scored for the last 4 min

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Only total immobility over last 4 min reported

B4_ethological.evidence: FST immobility is excluded per rubric

B5_social.evidence: compartments were separated by a black baffle to prevent interaction between the mice

B7_automated_classification.evidence: scored ... by two observers who were unaware of the treatment groups

E1_environment_type.evidence: cylindrical containers (20 cm height × 12 cm diameter) filled with 15 cm of water

E7_social_context.evidence: mice were individually placed in cylindrical containers ... separated by a black baffle

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or drinking water available

D1_continuity.evidence: FST 12 h, 24 h and 7 days post-psilocybin

D2_session_duration.evidence: The mice were video recorded for 6 min

D3_recording_days.evidence: Tests at 12 h, 24 h and 7 days

assays.assay_description: Two-bottle choice (1% sucrose vs water) in home cage for 2 h; bottles weighed; performed at baseline/after 21-day chronic CORT and 1 day after single psilocybin (0.1, 1.0, 2.5 mg/kg i.p.) or vehicle in CORT-exposed mice.

setup_habituation.evidence: A 1% sucrose solution was administered to the mice in their home cages prior to the baseline measurement

setup_restrain.evidence: The mice were free to consume liquid from either bottle

food_restriction.evidence: food was freely available; test conducted in home cage

water_restriction.evidence: one bottle containing drinking water and another bottle containing a 1% sucrose solution were placed in the cages for 2 h

time_to_assay.evidence: The SPT and NSFT were performed 1 and 2 days post-psilocybin injection, respectively

outcomes.summary: Chronic CORT reduced sucrose preference; a single dose of psilocybin (1.0 and 2.5 mg/kg, not 0.1 mg/kg) significantly rescued sucrose preference 24 h after treatment. Total fluid intake was unchanged.
outcomes.statistics: CORT vs non-CORT: t(88) = 10.39, p < 0.001; psilocybin: one-way ANOVA F(3, 68) = 4.267, p = 0.008; Dunnett post hoc 1.0 and 2.5 mg/kg significant
outcomes.evidence: It was found that the decrease in sucrose preference was significantly rescued by a single dose of psilocybin (one-way ANOVA: F 3, 68 = 4.267, p = 0.008; Figure 2(c)). Post hoc analysis revealed that psilocybin (1.0 and 2.5 mg/kg) significantly rescued sucrose preference.

B1_num_measures.evidence: Sucrose preference was calculated as 100% × sucrose solution consumption/(sucrose + water consumption); total fluid only in supplement

B4_ethological.evidence: Fluid consumption preference, not ethological acts

B7_automated_classification.evidence: the bottles were weighed to measure consumption

E1_environment_type.evidence: A 1% sucrose solution was administered to the mice in their home cages

E8_food_water.evidence: one bottle containing drinking water and another bottle containing a 1% sucrose solution were placed in the cages for 2 h

D1_continuity.evidence: The sucrose preference test (SPT) was performed before (baseline) and after chronic CORT exposure (1 day post-injection)

D2_session_duration.evidence: placed in the cages for 2 h

D4_baseline.evidence: We obtained baseline SPT data to determine whether chronic CORT exposure induced depression

assays.assay_description: White opaque Plexiglas box (50x40x20 cm) with 1 cm sawdust floor and five food pellets in centre; 24-h food-deprived mice; latency to feed over 5 min scored by two blinded observers; 2 days after single psilocybin (0.1, 1.0, 2.5 mg/kg i.p.) or vehicle in CORT-exposed mice.

setup_habituation.evidence: Only room habituation: 'allowed to habituate to the testing room for more than 1 h'

setup_restrain.evidence: placed in a corner of the NSFT box and allowed to move freely for 5 min

food_restriction.evidence: The mice were deprived of food for 24 h before the test

water_restriction.evidence: No water described in NSFT box

time_to_assay.evidence: The novelty-suppressed feeding test (NSFT) was performed 2 days after psilocybin treatment

outcomes.summary: Chronic CORT increased latency to feed; psilocybin reversed this 48 h after a single dose, with post hoc significance at 2.5 mg/kg.
outcomes.statistics: CORT vs non-CORT: t(34) = 4.014, p < 0.001; psilocybin: one-way ANOVA F(3, 68) = 2.771, p = 0.048; Dunnett post hoc 2.5 mg/kg significant
outcomes.evidence: this negative effect was reversed by treatment with psilocybin (one-way ANOVA: F 3, 68 = 2.771, p = 0.048). Post hoc analysis indicated the sustained antidepressant-like effects of 2.5 mg/kg psilocybin

B1_num_measures.evidence: The latency to feed was defined as the latency to bite a pellet or grasp it with the forepaws

B7_automated_classification.evidence: The latency to feed was evaluated by two observers

E1_environment_type.evidence: The box used for the NSFT (50 cm × 40 cm × 20 cm) was made of white opaque nonreflective Plexiglas

E3_bedding.evidence: The floor was covered with 1 cm of sawdust

E5_enrichment.evidence: Food pellets are the test stimulus, not enrichment

E7_social_context.evidence: The mice were then placed in a corner of the NSFT box (individually)

E8_food_water.evidence: five food pellets of the same shape and size were arranged radially in the middle of the box

D2_session_duration.evidence: allowed to move freely for 5 min

D3_recording_days.evidence: performed 2 days after psilocybin treatment (single day)

D5_followup.evidence: NSFT was performed 2 days after psilocybin treatment (48 h)

judge_notes: All candidates identified the same four behavioural assays (OFT, FST, SPT, NSFT); Western blot, Golgi staining and DCX immunofluorescence excluded as non-behavioural.
OFT time_to_assay corrected to early_2to24h (12 h = 720 min); NSFT corrected to short_term_1to7d (2880 min).
SPT D2 set to 61 min–6 h (score 2) for the stated 2-h session (qwen correct); SPT and NSFT D5 set to Yes since tests occurred 24 h and 48 h post-dose.
NSFT E8 = Yes because food pellets were accessible inside the apparatus (modal qwen/gemma).

setup_habituation set to not_reported for OFT/FST/NSFT: only within-session acclimation or testing-room acclimation described, which the rubric excludes. SPT habituation = yes based on prior sucrose exposure in home cage before baseline.
SPT home-cage bedding/social context not stated; scored 0 with low confidence rather than inferring (overrode deepseek's implied bedding).
OFT n_total set to 47 from ANOVA df F(3,43); FST n_total 72 from F(5,66).
